result.stdout: Usage: l3lint-mcp [--http] [--port <n>] [--token <token>] [--allow-origin <origin>]... [--version] [--help]. Default transport: stdio. --http serves Streamable HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (default port 7341). The token can also come from the L3LINT_MCP_TOKEN environment variable.
